description: Check that every plural message covers the categories its language actually uses. A language with six categories given two has no message at all for the other four, and the usual fallback is the key itself appearing in the interface. Both suffixed keys and ICU plural blocks are read. Also reports a declared category the language never selects, so the text is translated and never shown, and an ICU plural with no other branch, which the format requires. The category table is published. Pay 200000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

locales.description: The locale files to check. One entry per locale. Exactly one may be marked as the base; when none is, the first supplied is used and that is reported.

base.description: Whether this is the source locale the others are compared against.

locale.description: A language tag such as en, pt-BR or ar.

messages.description: This locale’s messages. A messages object, or JSON text, at most 2097152 bytes. Nested objects are flattened to separated keys, so a file written either way is read the same. Nothing is fetched: the files are supplied, so an arbitrary project can be audited.

plural_categories.description: Categories per language or locale, overriding the published table. A caller’s own list is the authority.

plural_suffixes.description: The key suffixes that mark a plural form. Defaults to _zero, _one, _two, _few, _many and _other.

name: locale_plural_coverage_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

complete_coverage.description: True only when every plural message covered every category its language uses and nothing was left unread.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

messages.description: Per plural message: its style, the categories present and the categories required.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

plural_category_table.description: The languages where the answer is not one and other, published so the judgement is auditable.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: Locale Plural Coverage Audit
